name: SUPRA Parallel Read Agent Strategy
description: Defines how read-only agents execute in parallel during Stage 5 of the Mission Center pipeline.

strategy.description: All selected read agents receive the mission context simultaneously and execute independently.
strategy.partial_results: accepted (non-blocking agents produce partial if timeout)

exploration.trigger: mission requires navigation or codebase mapping

analysis.trigger: mission requires compliance check or static analysis

research.trigger: mission requires external research or documentation lookup

runtime.trigger: mission requires runtime analysis or execution tracing

result_aggregation.partial_failure_handling: If an agent times out or fails, its output is excluded. Comparator notes the gap.
